|game_text=If opponent just initiated battle at a site where their total power is greater than yours, you may use 1 Force (or cause opponent to use 1 Force) to relocate one of your characters or vehicles to that site from a related location.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-46-Outflank-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The release-sheet slip, the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip show the original words (see [[Outflank (V)]], [[Outflank (V) (Errata 2)]] and [[Outflank (V) (Errata 3)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Outflank (V)]]): Virtual Block 3 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 46)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 4, slip 46. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If opponent just initiated battle at a site where their total power is greater than yours, may use 1 Force (or cause opponent to use 1 Force) to relocate one of your characters or vehicles to that site from a related location.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-46-Outflank.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 46 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 3 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1230_46">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock3Type (Virtual Block 3 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205219/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “If opponent just initiated battle at a site where their total power is greater than yours, you may use 1 Force (or cause opponent to use 1 Force) to relocate one of your characters or vehicles to that site from a related location.” '''What changed:''' One change: “you” is added (“you may use”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Outflank (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-outflank-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual3-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual3-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034607/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “If opponent just initiated battle at a site where their total power is greater than yours, may use 1 Force (or cause opponent to use 1 Force) to relocate one of your characters or vehicles to that site from a related location.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (46).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Outflank (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 38)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1230-46-front-master.png]]: “If opponent just initiated battle at a site where their total power is greater than yours, may use 1 Force (or cause opponent to use 1 Force) to relocate one of your characters or vehicles to that site from a related location.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
